description: Tifa, Aeris, Red XIII and Barret turn.
Cloud straddles a large black motorcycle.
Tifa stands beside a turquoise truck.
Cloud rides through shattered glass into the hall.
He skids around the truck as the others board.
The truck crashes through glass. Both vehicles descend to the lower level.
Cloud speeds through a doorway, the truck following.
Tifa drives, with Aeris beside her.
They burst through glass onto the raised roadway.
Motorcycle and truck speed away along the night highway.
